name: Creamy Chipotle Broth Bowls
subtitle: Honey-garlic beef, roasted zucchini and corn, black beans and rice in a creamy chipotle broth

macros.portion: About ½ cup rice, a heaping ½ cup beef (~3 oz cooked), 1 cup zucchini, ½ cup corn and ~1 cup broth with beans.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number. Excludes the optional honey drizzle (~30 kcal per bowl).

before: **20 oz ground beef** thawed in the fridge.
notes: A fitness-style brothy rice bowl, not a traditional Mexican dish: the beef is honey-garlic with cumin and cinnamon, and the broth gets its body from blended cottage cheese. The chipotle is set mild to medium; taste the hot broth and add more then. Keep the broth below a boil, first night and reheating, or the cottage cheese can turn grainy.

items: 2 chipotle peppers in adobo, plus 2 Tbsp adobo sauce
1 can black beans (15 oz), drained and rinsed
2½ cups cooked jasmine rice (frozen steamed rice)

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.body: Racks lower-middle and upper-middle. An **empty sheet pan** on the lower rack. Heat to 450°F.

steps.title: Zucchini and corn in
steps.body: Cut **30 oz zucchini** into ¾-inch dice and toss with **1 Tbsp + 1 tsp olive oil**, **½ tsp salt** and **¼ tsp pepper**. Spread on the hot pan, lower rack. On the second pan, toss **2½ cups frozen corn** with **1 tsp olive oil + ¼ tsp salt**, one layer, upper rack. Roast **12 min**.

steps.title: Prep while it roasts
steps.body: Blend **3¾ cups bone broth + 1¼ cups cottage cheese + 2 chipotles + 2 Tbsp adobo sauce + 2½ Tbsp tomato paste + 1 tsp smoked paprika** until completely smooth; leave it in the blender. In a small cup, stir **2½ Tbsp honey + 2½ Tbsp rice vinegar + 4 cloves minced garlic + 1¼ tsp salt + 1¼ tsp cumin + ¼ tsp cinnamon** until the honey dissolves. Drain and rinse **1 can black beans**. Cut **2 limes** into wedges.

steps.title: Stir the pans
steps.body: Flip the zucchini with a spatula and stir the corn. Back in for **10–20 min** more: pull the corn when it has browned spots, the zucchini when it's browned on most sides.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.body: Dry skillet over medium-high. Press in **20 oz beef** in a flat layer and leave it **5 min** to brown. Break it into crumbles and cook **3–4 min** more, until no pink remains and some bits are crisp. Spoon off any pooled fat.

steps.title: Glaze the beef
steps.body: Pour in the honey-garlic cup. Stir **1–2 min** until the liquid is gone and the beef is glossy. Move to a bowl and cover.

steps.title: Warm the broth
steps.body: Same skillet, medium-low. Pour in the blended broth, scrape up the browned bits, and add the **black beans**. Heat **4–5 min**, stirring, until steaming. Don't let it boil. Taste: salt first, then mince **1–2 more chipotles** in if you want more heat.

steps.title: Rice
steps.body: Microwave frozen rice per the package to get **2½ cups**.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.body: Each bowl: **½ cup rice**, a fifth of the beef, a fifth of the zucchini, **½ cup corn**, then **~1 cup broth with beans** ladled around the edge. Lime wedges, and a **½ Tbsp honey** drizzle if you like.

after: Pack 3 lunches with rice, beef, zucchini and corn. Broth and beans go in 3 separate jars, ~1 cup each, so the rice doesn't soak it up overnight.
Reheat the broth at 50% power, stirring every 30 seconds, until steaming but not boiling; heat the bowl separately and pour the broth over.

source.label: Adapted from Mason Woodruff, Kinda Healthy Recipes
